title: 사법정책자문위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Composition)
(1) The Committee shall consist of no more than seven members, including one chairperson.
(2) Members shall be commissioned by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court from among persons from various sectors of society who have extensive knowledge of the judicial system and enjoy high public esteem; the chairperson shall be designated by the Chief Justice from among the members.
(3) The Chief Justice may remove a member from office where the member is deemed unable to perform duties for unavoidable reasons or unsuitable to retain membership because of a violation of official duties or other circumstances.
(4) Members shall serve on a non-standing basis.
